title: Variadic Logger
hints: `format` can be two functions: one with no extra arguments that returns the rest of the text, and a template that finds the first `{}`, puts its first argument there, and calls itself with the rest of the arguments (lesson 9.03).
If you run out of arguments while `{}` are left, or have arguments left when no `{}` remain, throw `std::invalid_argument`.
requirements: `template <typename... Args> void log(Level, const Args&...)` with a fold expression
Format helper: `format("{} has {} HP", name, hp)` replacing `{}` with args in order (variadic recursion)
Throw `std::invalid_argument` if the count of `{}` doesn't match args
